# Municipal Ordinance No. 07, Series of 2005

**Ordinance supporting the National Health Insurance Program**

## Summary

This ordinance formalizes the municipality's continued support for the National Health Insurance Program (NHIP) and its governing rules as defined in [[RA-7875]] and amended by [[RA-9241]]. It outlines the scope of implementation, undertakings of the municipality, enforcement agency, and effectivity clause. The ordinance aims to ensure access to essential goods, health, and other social services for the underprivileged, sick, elderly, disabled, women, and children.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section I, Title** - "AN ORDINANCE adopting of and/or continued support to the National Health Insurance Program and its governing rules as set forth in [[RA-7875]]".
2.  **Section II, Authority and Purpose** - As provided for Article II, Section 15 the Philippine Constitution, it states that the "State shall protect and promote the right to health of the people and to instill health consciousness among them"; and Article XIII, Section 11 further states that the State shall adopt an integrated and comprehensive approach to health development which shall endeavor to make essential goods, health and other social services available to all the people at affordable cost. There shall be priority for the needs of the underprivileged, sick, elderly, disabled, women, and children.
3.  **Section III, Scope of Application** - This ordinance shall be adopted by the Municipality/City in the implementation of the National Health Insurance Program.
4.  **Section IV, Undertakings of the Municipality/City**
    4.1 Adoption of and/or continued support to the National Health Insurance Program and its governing rules as set forth in [[RA-7875]], as amended by [[RA-9241]], and its Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations. Such support shall include active advocacy for NHIP participation by private and non-government organizations within its territorial jurisdictions, mandating compliance to NHIP rules by entries required to obtain LGU permits/licenses, and the setting up of revolving funds for medicines in owned or managed hospitals, as may be warranted under existing rules/guidelines or similar future arrangements and/or issuance.
    4.2 Grant of authority to the Mayor to enter into any favorable modification of this Agreement;
    4.3 Continuous allocation of funds as the LGU's counterpart subsidy for qualified beneficiaries within its jurisdiction as evidenced by a Certificate of Availability of Funds; and
5.  **Section V, Enforcement Agency** - The Municipal Health Office, [[Sangguniang Bayan]], and Municipal Treasurer's Office are hereby mandated to strictly enforce this Ordinance.
6.  **Section VI, Repealing Clause** - Any part of this Ordinance that is declared null and voids shall not have any effect on the entirety of the Ordinance.
7.  **Section VII, Effectivity Clause** - This Ordinance shall take effect after furnishing a copy of this Ordinance to the President, Her Excellency [[Gloria Macapagal Arroyo]], and President/Chief Executive Officer of the Philippine Health Corporation, [[Hon. Francisco T. Duque III]], M.D., and the [[Hon. Tirso L. Enverga]], Provincial Governor of [[Tirso L. Enverga]], for his information and the approval of the application for accreditation of the Rural Health Unit of Pitogo, Quezon to the Philippine Health Insurance Corporation.
